entries.title: Home redesign — calm ChatGPT-style shell, drawers, orb hero, status badges
bullets: The loud home is gone. A collapsible sidebar (hamburger, open/close like ChatGPT/Claude) replaces the wall of cards. The center is now a calm hero: a big Loren orb, “Ask me anything.”, and a typewriter that cycles what she can do, with the ask bar right under it.

Sidebar items open drawers instead of dumping everything on the page — Platform Tools, Chats, and Projects each slide out; “Jump back in” is now the Chats drawer. Activity and Memory stay as full pages.

Way calmer color: subtle mono icon tiles (one accent) instead of a dozen gradients. Every tool now carries a build-status badge — ✓ operational (QA'd, live), β beta (about to ship), α alpha (being tried). Operational tools are also pinned as stationary quick-launches in the rail.
AI-curated chat titles: a new thread is auto-named from your first prompt (short, Title Case, relatable), with its date/time — no more “find me all of the properties…” as the title.
Full-width throughout, margins maximized. Additive — new shell components + tool registry, existing pages untouched.
entries.bench: collapsible rail · Tools/Chats/Projects drawers · orb + typewriter hero · status badges (✓/β/α) · AI titles (orchestrator v23) · full-width

entries.where: GitHub · onepropertymarket + Supabase (loren-profile v1, loren-orchestrator v22)
entries.title: Living profile — memory now absorbs your whole footprint in the system
bullets: Memory is now two layers. The living profile at the top of /loren/memory is compiled automatically from what you actually do: profile & identity, roles, onboarding, investing habits, leads from every channel, credits & purchasing, and how you use the system.
Loren knows all of it automatically — the orchestrator injects your living profile into every reply alongside the facts you curate.
New loren-profile edge function (service-role, scoped to you); refreshes on demand.
entries.bench: loren-profile compiler · injected into orchestrator v22 · living-profile section on Memory

entries.title: Perpetual memory — Loren remembers you, your business, and your team
bullets: New Memory page at /loren/memory — everything Loren knows, grouped into About you / Your business / Your team. Add, pin, or remove any fact.
Loren uses the memory in every reply and learns durable new facts on her own via a remember tool.
entries.bench: loren_memory table + RLS · memory injected · remember tool

New owner-scoped loren_projects table linked via project_id.

entries.title: Activity board — a live, branded timeline of everything Loren does
